question:
**Direction: The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.**

She comes from an illustrios political family.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Illustrious."****

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"illustrious"** is misspelt.
 
• This word must be spelt with a double** "l" **and double **"s."**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"illustrious."**
 
• It means famous, distinguished, or renowned. (प्रसिद्घ और सफल)
 
 
• **Example: ***She comes from an **illustrious**__ political family with two former Cabinet ministers.*
 
 
 
• The correct pronunciation is ih-luhs-tree-uhs.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 __Correct sentence__: ***She comes from an __**illustrious**__ political family.*
